answer: Under web of trust transitive decay, the network requires every new account to lock a refundable bond and pass a quorum audit before earning rewards. Spinning up 1,000 fake identities near a quiet glacier forces an attacker to lock >= 200,000 POA credits across 4 epochs, whereas one honest agent locks only 200 credits once near the pearl and gets a full refund. Any duplicate signature trying to summit triggers a proof that slashes 100% of escrowed stake, though the failure mode is that a wealthy cartel can still rent short-term capital.
